d: In this video, we are taking a detailed look at the all-new OPPO Find X10 Pro Max. This phone comes with a 6.78” 1.5K OLED display with a 144Hz LTPO refresh rate, the MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro processor, 12GB LPDDR5X RAM, 512GB UFS 4.1 storage, and an 8000mAh battery with 80W wired and 50W wireless charging. For cameras, you get a 200MP main camera, a 200MP 3x periscope telephoto camera, a 200MP ultrawide camera, and a 50MP ultrawide selfie camera. It also supports 8K video recording, 4K 120fps recording, Open Gate video and Hasselblad camera modes. The phone is running on ColorOS 17…
